home.title: AI Assistant for Scientific Literature
home.subtitle: A comprehensive solution to help you search, automatically screen, and synthesize information from reputable academic sources.
home.features_subtitle: Powerful tools to optimize your research workflow
home.feature1_desc: Quickly search on Google Scholar. Automatically extract abstracts and assess reliability.
home.feature2_desc: Evaluate the relevance of papers based on your predefined criteria.
home.feature3_desc: Manage your paper library and automatically export important information in standard formats.
home.step1_desc: Set your research question and criteria
home.step3_desc: AI evaluates and filters out irrelevant documents
home.step4_desc: Chat with documents and extract data
